name: maskera-monorepo
description: Swedish-first, client-side PII redaction for AI apps

scripts.test: pnpm check:benchmarks && pnpm check:fixtures && pnpm check:training-privacy && pnpm check:tooling && pnpm -r test
scripts.typecheck: for p in packages/core packages/ner apps/demo; do node node_modules/typescript-7/lib/tsc.js -p $p/tsconfig.json --noEmit || exit 1; done && node node_modules/typescript-7/lib/tsc.js -p packages/ner/tsconfig.runtime-test.json --noEmit
scripts.eval:domain: pnpm -C packages/core build && pnpm -C packages/ner build && pnpm -C packages/ner eval:domain
scripts.eval:domain:clinical: pnpm -C packages/core build && pnpm -C packages/ner build && MASKERA_PROFILE=clinical pnpm -C packages/ner eval:domain
scripts.lint: pnpm check:benchmarks && pnpm check:fixtures && pnpm check:training-privacy && biome check .
